name: Remada invertida no Smith
movement: Inverted row under a fixed Smith bar, body straight, pull chest to bar and lower.
cue: Posicione-se sob a barra do Smith e mantenha o corpo alinhado. Puxe o peito à barra e desça com controle.
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Original fitness animation sprite sheet. Exactly six sequential poses in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid with six equal square cells.
